cohort: 30 women with Post-Cesarean section Infection in Bent-Al-Huda & Al-Habboubi hospital in in Thi-Qar province.
finding: The rate of bacterial isolates in patients with Post-Cesarean section Infection was 76.6%, with E. coli (34.8%) and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (30.4%) being the most common, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing showed variable sensitivity, with the isolates being most sensitive to chloramphenicol and Imipenem.
